notes.title: Patch Note 2.5.0
notes.notes:
Patch 2.5.0
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/34fe152146a6e11a5bd32a41699eca74f892a9f0.png"]
Brazen Blaze Season 6 Act: 1 has begun!
Starting this season, we will be adjusting the match rule schedule so that both Round Team Match and Survival Mode are always available.


We would also like to announce some adjustments to game balance.

Valkyrie, in particular, was introduced as a Runner with excellent mobility and support abilities. However, her solo combat power was also high, resulting in a higher overall win rate than other Runners.

Therefore, we will be making downward adjustments to balance her with other Runners without compromising the appeal of Valkyrie. At the same time, we will be improving runners with low win rates, aiming to improve overall balance.



We hope these adjustments will provide you with a fresher, more strategic competitive environment.


In addition, previously released bundles will be re-released and rotated weekly.

We hope you continue to enjoy Brazen Blaze in Season 6!


■Featured Content
- Changed the battle rules settings.

  - Round Team Match and Survival mode will now be available at all times.

  - Assist Items have been removed from Round Team Match (BO3)

- Battle Pass "Season 6 Act: 1" has begun.

- "VELVET" and "MAGUS" bundles are now available in the shop.

- Daily shop displays have been updated.


■Balancing
・VALKYRIE

▼ Decreased HP (800 → 750)

▼ Reduced Boost Dash speed

▼ Increased cooldown of Skill “Accelerator” (35s → 40s)

▼ Decreased healing amount of Ultimate “Sanctuary” (300 → 200)



・VELVET

△ Increased charge speed of Main Weapon “Photon Blade”

 （Lv1: 0.7s → 0.5s / Lv2: 0.9s → 0.7s）


・Sub Weapon “Shake Grenade”

△ Increased knockback power when hitting an enemy at max upgrade



・Sub Weapon “Air Mine”

△ Increased damage when hitting an enemy (200 → 250)


■Bug Fix
-Fixed a bug where the assist item “Laser Cannon” could be used to attack a wide area with specific inputs.
-Fixed a bug where changes to the master volume setting were not saved when adjusted alone in the options menu.

A Message From The Director:
We would like to provide an update regarding the features originally planned for this release: “Player Addition” and “Instant NPC Match Start.”
To ensure stability, we will first roll out the feature that allows players to access Training and Challenge modes while waiting in matchmaking.

Based on how this feature is used, we will gradually implement the Player Addition and Instant NPC Match Start features in a future update. Following our investigation into the recent bug, we discovered that issues occur when the number of team members changes during the Runner Selection phase. As a result, we are prioritizing the release of the Training and Challenge access during the matchmaking feature, so we can observe when players tend to join or leave. This information will help us safely deploy the remaining features.

We sincerely apologize for the repeated delays and appreciate your continued patience and understanding.
Thank you for bearing with us.

Featured Content
Players can now access areas outside the lobby (such as Training or Challenge) while waiting in matchmaking.
 - The number of players in matchmaking is shown in the top right corner of the screen.
 　
Note: If you're in a team, each member can move to other areas individually.
Note: If the team is created in a private lobby, voice chat between team members is available in all areas.
Note: Although Closet access during matchmaking was originally planned, it has been disabled in this update due to a confirmed bug.

Match End
- After a match ends, players can now choose to return to the lobby with their current team or leave the team. Previously, the rematch function would immediately begin the character pick phase. Now it has been changed to return players to the lobby so they can do other things while waiting.

Other
- Shortened the detection time for player disconnection during matches.

Bug Fix
- Issue in the New York City (Day) stage where players could respawn inside objects.
- Issue in the tutorial where falling out of bounds via a specific order could cause progress to become stuck.

Known Bugs
- Players other than the Team Leader may be unable to select Challenge Mode during matchmaking. 　
Note: This can be resolved by entering the Training Room, which will enable Challenge Mode selection. A fix for this issue is planned in next week’s update.
- In some cases, when returning to the lobby after a match, the Team Leader’s main console may not display correctly.

　- Stock Team Match: Win +1, Loss -1

　- PRESIDENT

notes.title: Changes regarding the Open Beta
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone participating in the Brazen Blaze Open Beta!

The first day of the Open Beta was a big success. We are delighted that many Runners have played the game. Your valuable feedback and play data will be shared with the development team immediately to improve the game's quality.

Now, let us explain the issues and measures that will be taken in response to the results of the first day. Currently, there are two playable game modes: 3v3 Stock Team Match and Survival. Due to fluctuations in player numbers and the dispersion caused by the two rules, the matchmaking system is not functioning adequately. The feature is intended to enable teams to form and compete against players of similar skill levels. However, there are many situations where the matchmaking time is long, matches do not start, and experienced players are frequently matched with beginners.
Therefore, starting today, we will limit the times for 3v3 Stock Team Match. The schedule is as follows:

▲ Increased Shake Grenade's object-destroying power.
▲ Enabled Boost Dashing while holding Combat Knife.
▲ Made Combat Knife to stumble your opponent when thrown.
 
Other changes
- Altered all Runner’s Ultimate Gauge charge amount while an attack lands.
- The duration of invincibility mode when slammed to a wall has been reduced from 2 seconds to 1 seconds. 
- Changed the direction a player will face when they get slammed into a wall to facing the original direction when getting hit.
- Adjusted objects to break more easily when players get slammed into an object.
 
Gameplay
- Added dashing assist to make it easier to dash toward a stunned enemy or ally.
- Adjusted the position of Sub Weapon holster.
- Enhanced Shake Grenade explosion if shaken after the detonation countdown began.
- Updated the Shake Grenade’s sound effect.
- Added a function to throw Combat Knife in style.
- Updated the marker display function.
- BGM and SFX fades during stuns.
- Adjusted the finger to hold on the trigger when holding a gun. Additionally, finger will pull the trigger when firing.
- Adjusted the color of the gun's crosshair.
- Enhanced the effect of reviving from stun.
- Changed the UI display during the start and during the end of battles.
- Added Runner voices at the beginning of battles.
- Added a rare chance for a shooting star to show during RIOT Finisher.
- Updated VELVET's Finisher motion.
- Updated the sound effect when activating SUNSHINE skill.
- Updated some effects on SUNSHINE Finisher.
 
Stage
- Enabled shadow rendering through “Shadow Quality During Battle” option.
- Enabled destroying trash cans and street lamps with guns.
- Enhanced car explosion effects with debris.
- Added damage for car explosions.
- When a player is hit by blowing water from a fire hydrant, the player will be blown upward.
- Glasses in the stage can be broken by throwing objects at it. 
- Updated effect when object breaks on SteamVR.
 
Matching
- Updated matching system.
- Team members would appear in the same Lobby, and appearance will reflect the skins selected in Closet.
- After a certain duration, matching will occur with players from other regions.
- Matched team through invitation will remain as a team even after returning to the Lobby.
- Added "Join" button to notification when a player receives an invitation.
 
Options
- Render shadows during battles depending on the shadow quality settings. Available on all devices for SteamVR; Only available for Meta Quest 3 on the Meta Quest platform.
- Added option to select shadow quality during battle.
- Enabled players to access Quick Menu even when they are near the terminal.
- Enabled players to move around even while the Options and Quick Menu are displayed.
- Added option to swap left and right buttons for quick menu and marker placement.
- Added option to select auto or manual mode for boost punching.
- When set to auto, boost dash will automatically activate when punching if possible.
- Enabled players to set their player list up to the following numbers: 100 follows, 500 followers, and 20 blocked users.
- Added function to show new followers.
- Changed the language setting displays in options.
 
UI Design
 - Changed the digits of team code for Online Matches, and made it to use only numbers.
- Enlarged dialog box to enter team codes for Online Matches.
- Updated the design of the Quick Menu.
- Updated all dialog screens.
- Updated UI display when using voice chat.
- Updated design of various keyboards.
- Added game title logo to be displayed at the beginning of the game.
- Updated the wording of some of the authentication dialogs during the start of the game.
- Updated the design during loading.
 
Other

- Enabled players to replay Tutorial from the Training Room.
- Updated Tutorial.

- Updated the sound effect when VELVET successfully slashes and hits.
